title: Documentation review gate
description:
Documentation quality regressions currently surface only through manual audits. Define an automatic documentation review gate so the documentation tree stays accurate after cleanup.

## Background

The gate follows the repository's AI-review script pattern with a documentation-specific prompt (decision pinned 2026-07-06). Review dimensions: statements match the current source tree; adopter docs describe the shipped surface, with repo-local configuration explicitly signalled; current behavior stated without legacy narration; no hardcoded counts that silently rot; links and referenced paths resolve.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-1: A documentation review gate is registered as an automatic gate backed by the repository's AI-review script pattern with a documentation-specific prompt covering the five review dimensions above
- [ ] [hard] REQ-2: The gate produces structured findings
- [ ] [hard] REQ-3: The gate passes on the repository's documentation tree at the time this issue completes
- [ ] [hard] REQ-4: The gate registry description states when to apply the gate to future documentation work
